title: Optimizing Recourse Under Predictive Multiplicity
abstract: arXiv:2611.05774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Algorithmic recourse identifies modifications that can change an unfavorable model prediction into a favorable one. Under predictive multiplicity, similarly performing models can disagree on individual predictions, so recourse valid for one model may fail for another. We formulate robust recourse under predictive multiplicity as a budget-constrained minimization of the worst-case validity loss across a competing set of models, which can include models with different architectures or from different hypothesis classes. We propose an oracle-efficient algorithm called ORPM and prove sufficient conditions for its convergence. We evaluate ORPM on one synthetic and five real datasets, and competing sets consist of linear, neural, mixed, and decision-tree models. translated_title: 预测多重性下的追索优化
translated_abstract: 算法追索旨在识别能够将模型的不利预测改变为有利预测的修改方案。在预测多重性存在的情形下，性能相近的模型可能会对同一个体做出不同的预测，因此对某一模型有效的追索方案对另一模型可能失效。我们将预测多重性下的鲁棒追索问题形式化为一个带预算约束的最小化问题，即在相互竞争的一组模型上最小化最坏情况下的有效性损失，这组模型可以包含不同架构或来自不同假设类别的模型。我们提出了一种名为ORPM的oracle高效算法，并证明了其收敛的充分条件。我们在一个合成数据集和五个真实数据集上评估了ORPM，竞争模型集合包括线性模型、神经网络、混合模型和决策树模型。实验结果表明，在许多测试场景中，优化间隙上界不断下降且有效性较高，与为特定模型类别设计的基线方法相比表现优越。
tldr: 该论文提出ORPM算法，通过在带预算约束下最小化相互竞争的模型集合上的最坏情况有效性损失，解决了预测多重性下的鲁棒算法追索问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ORPM, an oracle-efficient algorithm that addresses robust algorithmic recourse under predictive multiplicity by minimizing the worst-case validity loss across a competing set of models under a budget constraint.
